scope: Fresh unaudited mechanics frontier after Batch 474, excluding every skill with a registered current-evidence audit.
selection_method: Selected the eight shortest canonical mechanics records whose skill IDs were not represented by a registered current-evidence audit.

records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ136. The user performs an aura-infused overhead punch; if it connects, a Ki Blast hits the downed opponent, producing the documented two-hit pseudo-Strike sequence. Current Xenoverse 2 skill evidence reports 10% damage for the follow-up Ki Blast and confirms the PQ136 endpoint; exact startup/frame data, universal scaling, and reward probability remain unresolved.

400-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ115, "Extreme Battle with Android 13!". The user creates a large Ki ball that advances while tracking/heat-seeking the opponent; current Xenoverse 2 skill evidence classifies it as a long-range 15-hit projectile and reports 30% total damage. Exact tracking parameters, frames, and reward probability remain unresolved.

100-Ki Strike Super available from the TP Medal Shop. The user punches forward to create an energy burst; an uncharged release hits once for a source-reported 10% damage, while holding the input produces up to three projectiles for a source-reported 15% total and increases range. Current evidence also records CaC usability after Supreme Kai of Time content; exact charge timing and scaling remain unresolved.

500-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from Conton City Tournament Match 5, "The Fated Finale." The opening restrains the opponent in a Ki-gear effect so the target does not fly away, then the user fires a large Ki sphere for a documented 14-hit sequence and about 50% total damage. Current evidence also reports that the restraint can persist for 5 seconds even if the user is struck during the opening; exact frames and scaling remain unresolved.

100-Ki Ki Blast Super learned through Bojack training. The user creates a protective green barrier in front of themselves; additional input expands the barrier up to two times. Current Xenoverse 2 skill evidence describes the barrier as protecting the user from attacks and reports 2% damage per offensive contact. Exact duration, frame behavior, and scaling remain unresolved.

100-Ki Strike counter Super used by Cooler (Final Form) and obtainable through his training. The user holds a counter stance for about one second; if struck by a Ki Blast during the window, they rush to the opponent and perform a hard-knockdown strike. Current skill evidence reports about 20% damage and specifies that the counter reacts to Ki Blast-based attacks rather than melee attacks; exact counter-window frames remain unresolved.

300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate learned through Yamcha training. The user creates and throws a large Ki ball; up to 17 additional inputs make the projectile continue tracking the opponent, producing a documented 1–18-hit sequence. Current skill evidence reports 5% damage per hit and long-range knockback behavior; exact tracking parameters, frames, and patch-independent scaling remain unresolved.

100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ147, "Caulifla's Saiyan Search." The user sets up eight Ki projectiles overhead; another input detonates/redirects them so they home toward the opponent, with current skill evidence classifying the move as a short-range 1–8-hit attack and reporting up to about 20% damage. Exact setup timing, homing parameters, and per-hit scaling remain unresolved.

evidence_policy: Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence is prioritized. Source-reported numerical values remain source-bound; unsupported exact frames, scaling, hidden interactions, and reward probabilities are not inferred.
exact_next: Run a fresh unaudited mechanics frontier census excluding Batch 475 and every prior registered current-evidence audit, then continue the canonical research/synchronization cycle.
